svg.title: The eight dimensions of responsible AI
svg.desc: A hub labeled responsible AI connects to eight cards. Controllability means mechanisms to monitor and steer system behavior. Privacy and security means obtaining, using, and protecting data and models appropriately. Safety means preventing harmful output and misuse. Fairness means considering the impact on different groups of stakeholders. Veracity and robustness means correct output even with unexpected or adversarial input. Explainability means understanding and evaluating outputs. Transparency means helping stakeholders make informed choices about using the system. Governance means best practices across the AI supply chain, for providers and deployers alike.
svg.text: The eight dimensions of responsible AI
